notes: Control = published in window, carried strong Tier-2 critical reception, shows no evidence of bestseller-scale readership.

Readership scale measured by Goodreads rating counts checked 2026-08-11 via the Goodreads search listing. Bucket benchmark: Fourth Wing, 3,900,856 ratings. Control range in this bucket: 9,690 to 37,060 — roughly two orders of magnitude below.
This is a weak, non-random comparison group. It supports statements about what distinguishes these bestsellers from these non-sellers, and nothing stronger.
